name: io.github.charliemtnez/ghost-inspector-mcp
description: Analyze, validate and safely update Ghost Inspector end-to-end browser tests

environmentVariables.name: GHOST_INSPECTOR_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your personal Ghost Inspector key, from Account Settings then API Access. Read fresh on every call, never written to disk, never echoed back.

environmentVariables.name: GHOST_INSPECTOR_ORG_ID
environmentVariables.description: Organization id. Needed only to execute a validation; read it from gi_whoami.

environmentVariables.name: GHOST_INSPECTOR_ALLOW_WRITES
environmentVariables.description: Set to exactly true to let the five write tools act. They are listed either way; anything else keeps the server read-only.

Set to "true" to let gi_run_test execute a stored test against a real environment, which can submit a real form. Deliberately not implied by GHOST_INSPECTOR_ALLOW_WRITES: an edit can be rolled back from the backup this server returns, a submission cannot. Defaults to false.
environmentVariables.name: GHOST_INSPECTOR_ALLOW_RUNS
GHOST_INSPECTOR_BACKUP_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Where the write path saves the prior definition of every test it touches, credentials removed. Defaults to ~/.ghost-inspector-mcp/backups, created owner-only.
